description: Frozen edit-preflight tasks for angular-spotify. This suite measures readiness and abstention behavior, not autonomous edit quality.
notes: Safe tasks are concrete local edits. Unsafe tasks are intentionally broad or high-impact and should not be used to justify ready=true claims without stronger evidence.

tasks.title: Tight auth header edit
tasks.query: update how authorization token headers are attached to API requests
tasks.notes: A local interceptor change should be navigable with an edit-ready preflight.

tasks.title: Playback next-track behavior
tasks.query: change the logic that skips to the next song
tasks.notes: Targets the playback API surface used in retrieval/discovery fixtures.

tasks.title: Recently played fetch flow
tasks.query: edit how recently played tracks are fetched
tasks.notes: Concrete API behavior with a narrow blast radius.

tasks.title: Album store loading flow
tasks.query: modify how saved albums are loaded in application state

tasks.title: Local persistence helper
tasks.query: change how browser session data is persisted locally

tasks.title: Playlist API request helper
tasks.notes: Exact-name adjacent edit on a concrete service.

tasks.title: Rewrite auth behavior everywhere
tasks.query: rewrite every auth-related request and token flow across the app in one change
tasks.notes: Broad, cross-cutting request that should not be treated as a ready local edit.

tasks.title: Migrate all NgRx state at once
tasks.query: replace all ngrx state management with a new pattern across the whole app
tasks.notes: Migration-scale ask with intentionally high impact.

tasks.title: Refactor every interceptor path
tasks.query: refactor all interceptors and token refresh behavior throughout the repository
tasks.notes: Multiple coupled subsystems, not a single safe edit target.

tasks.title: Remove analytics globally
tasks.query: remove every analytics and tracking hook from the entire app
tasks.notes: Repository-wide removal request intended to test abstention.
